answer: Each identity locks 70 and files a delivery commitment on a ledge: one cedar relic due by epoch close. Each cedar relic bears a struck serial; auditors weigh it at the ledge; short weight or late delivery burns the bond. First filing is 36, the k-th 36+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,533,500, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented couriers fail: a relic delivered twice voids both bonds. An honest agent pays 36 once, keeps its bond.
